Specifically, upon returning to the Gallery, I must attempt the remaining "east" direction before considering the task complete.

Next time, I will maintain a strict record of which specific directions have been attempted from each room. I will only issue "DONE" when I am in a room where every available direction has already been tried and led to a previously visited room.
